contact_event_line_search.candidate_sampling: bounded factors between each representative event factor and the nearest larger canonical backtracking factor, plus the event factor itself when admissible
contact_event_line_search.event: predicted zero crossing of a fixed-search normal gap along the current Newton correction
contact_event_line_search.failure_behavior: If no canonical or supplemental candidate satisfies the unchanged merit rule, preserve the original fail-closed line-search failure.
contact_event_line_search.representative_event_factors: minimum, median, and maximum unique predicted factors

failure_policy: Preserve each failed case; continue independent primary cases sequentially; block only dependent reference/replay and final candidate gates.

governing.solver_policy_digest_role: Existing digest binds frozen configured policy values; R2.3 source and contract hashes bind the supplemental trial-generation implementation.

additional_change.description: Adds read-only penalty-contact snapshots and bounded trial-factor probes around predicted fixed-search gap activation after canonical backtracking fails. The contact residual/tangent law, physical inputs, thresholds, convergence/failure criteria, linear backend, and fallback policy are unchanged.

mechanics_requalification.description: Requalify the existing bounded routes on the source containing the coupled normal/friction active-set recovery. This is a production mechanics change and is not represented as tooling-only.

parent.preservation: All R1 files and historical R1 results remain unchanged; the R2 authorization does not retroactively certify them.

scope.independent_reference_cases: Independent formulation-matched reference for each primary case that passes.
scope.primary_cases: Fresh production execution for both routes at all three frozen levels.

replay_cases.ACTIVE_SET: M2 only, as frozen in the parent R1 contract.
replay_cases.PENALTY: M1 only, as frozen in the parent R1 contract.

source_identity.execution_sha_semantics: Exact final R2.3 freeze commit is supplied in each generated per-case authorization and runner process manifest.

source_sha_semantics: The exact executable source SHA is supplied by the per-case authorization after this contract, binding, tests, and runner are committed.
